title: Liṅgāṣṭakam
author: Traditional
intro: Eight verses in praise of the Shiva liṅga, each ending with the refrain tat praṇamāmi sadāśiva-liṅgam, 'I bow to that liṅga of Sadāśiva', followed by a closing verse. It is one of the most widely sung hymns in daily Shiva puja.
note: The eight verses use a 16-mātrā rhythm in four beats (the Dodhaka pattern — ◡ ◡ — ◡ ◡ — ◡ ◡ — —, where ◡◡ may replace —). The closing verse is in Anuṣṭubh.
